tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: Learn how this module exports, updates, validates, and imports an APEX application through APEXlang.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Set Up the Environment
tutorials.description: Install Visual Studio Code and its extensions, create a database connection, and configure the SQLcl MCP server.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Set Up the APEXlang Skills Repository
tutorials.description: Use SQLcl to install the Oracle APEX and database skills.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Export TAP and Review the APEXlang Project
tutorials.description: Export TAP and identify familiar components in the generated APEXlang project.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Add a New Component and Validate the Project
tutorials.description: Add the Candidate Search Help region and validate the APEXlang project.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Import TAP and Verify the Change
tutorials.description: Import the updated TAP application and verify the new region in APEX.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving live help.
